figures.caption: Figure 1: Directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) illustrating the assumed missing mechanisms when missingness occurs only in the mediators. Panels (a)–(f) represent, in order, MCAR, MAR, and four increasingly general MNAR mechanisms. All graphs are conditioned on X, which may have directed edges to all variables.

Figure 2: Boxplots of percentage bias for the estimated effects across four methods (CC, MICE, MNAR-EM, and Oracle) under four missingness mechanisms. Results are based on 500 Monte Carlo replications with n = 2000.
